origin: Rexal FMI Racing emerged from the vibrant, albeit chaotic, Italian amateur racing scene of the late 1990s. Founded by childhood friends Marco Rossi, a talented mechanic with a knack for squeezing every last drop of performance from aging engines, and Alessia Bianchi, a shrewd businesswoman who secured early sponsorships from local businesses, the team initially focused on hill climb events with a modified Fiat Uno. Their early days were characterized by shoestring budgets, late nights in Marco's cramped garage, and a healthy dose of Italian passion. A pivotal moment came when they secured a sponsorship from Rexal, a regional tool manufacturer, providing them with the financial stability to enter the more competitive world of regional circuit racing.
philosophy: Rexal FMI Racing operates on a 'never give up' philosophy, prioritizing driver development and extracting maximum performance from limited resources. Their approach to car development is pragmatic, focusing on reliability and incremental improvements rather than radical innovation. The team culture is one of camaraderie and mutual respect, fostering a family-like atmosphere where everyone's contribution is valued, even if it's just bringing the best espresso to the track.
achievements: Regional Circuit Racing Championship - Class B Winner (2015)
Multiple podium finishes in the Italian Hill Climb Championship (2010-2014)
Secured Rexal sponsorship, providing financial stability (1999)
Finished 7th overall in the Italian GT Cup (2020)

teamPrincipal.name: Alessia Bianchi
teamPrincipal.background: Alessia is the driving force behind Rexal FMI Racing, handling team management, sponsorship acquisition, and strategic planning. Her unwavering determination and sharp business acumen have kept the team afloat through thick and thin.

keyFigures.name: Marco Rossi
keyFigures.description: Marco is the mechanical genius behind Rexal FMI's success, possessing an uncanny ability to coax speed and reliability from even the most temperamental engines. He's known for his hands-on approach and encyclopedic knowledge of motorsport engineering.

headquarters: Rexal FMI Racing operates out of a modest workshop on the outskirts of Modena, Italy, the heartland of Italian motorsport. Their facilities are basic but functional, comprising a small garage, a rudimentary machine shop, and a cramped office space filled with racing memorabilia.
fanBase: Rexal FMI Racing enjoys a loyal following among local racing enthusiasts who appreciate their underdog spirit and dedication to the sport. Their fans are known for their passionate support, often lining the fences at regional races with Italian flags and handmade banners.
